description: This file contains unit tests for noVNC authentication helper functions, verifying URL construction, token issuance and consumption, token expiration, and password generation.

methods.name: buildNoVncDirectUrl
methods.description: Constructs the direct URL for noVNC connection without a password.

methods.name: buildNoVncObserverTokenUrl
methods.description: Builds the URL containing a noVNC observer token.

methods.name: buildNoVncObserverTargetUrl
methods.description: Constructs a noVNC observer target URL including optional password as URL fragment parameters.

methods.name: consumeNoVncObserverToken
methods.description: Validates and consumes a noVNC observer token, returning connection parameters if valid.

methods.name: generateNoVncPassword
methods.description: Generates an 8-character alphanumeric password for noVNC.

methods.name: issueNoVncObserverToken
methods.description: Issues a one-time token for noVNC observer sessions with specified TTL.

methods.name: resetNoVncObserverTokensForTests
methods.description: Resets the internal state of observer tokens, used in testing.

ctags.name: observerPassword
ctags.pattern: /^    const observerPassword = "a+b c&d"; \/\/ pragma: allowlist secret$/
